services.name: Residency Program
services.desc: Residency training is self-directed training time for circus professionals to develop skills and create acts in a supportive community environment. Monthly residency is available for professional circus artists, graduates of Esh’s Professional Prep Program, and graduates of national and international full-time professional circus training programs. To inquire about specific hours and studio availability or if you are interested in participating in the residency program, email info@eshcircusarts.com with “Residency” in the subject line. Please be sure to include the following information: Weekly and daily training is available for visiting professionals for $30/week or $10/day; please email
